# Document360

Knowledge bases hosted by Document360. There is no source repo: content comes from a project export the customer runs, or from the public knowledge base site.

## Detect

- Rendered HTML loads images from `cdn.document360.io` and references Document360 throughout the markup.
- Article URLs follow `/docs/<slug>`, optionally behind workspace and language segments (`/v2/docs/<slug>`, `/docs/en/<slug>`).
- Callouts render as `<div class="infoBox">`, `warningBox`, `errorBox`, `successBox`.
- An export ZIP contains per-article `.md`, `.html` or `.json` files and a media folder.

## Get the source

Mintlify's guide for this platform: https://www.mintlify.com/docs/migration/document360.md

### From the repo

None; content comes from a project export or the live site.

### From an export

The customer runs it in the portal: **Content tools > Import and export > Import and export project > Export project**. Steps: https://docs.document360.com/docs/exporting-your-document360-project-as-a-zip-file-json

- Select **All** under "Include new or modified articles in"; the default date filter drops older articles.
- Select every maintained workspace, language and category, and **Include media files** (otherwise images stay as hosted URLs).
- Each new export overwrites the previous ZIP; download it as soon as it is ready.
- File type depends on the editor and the export: a single-language export writes `.md` for Markdown-editor articles and `.html` for WYSIWYG and Advanced WYSIWYG articles; a multi-language export writes `.json` for every article. Handle all three.
- Also ask for the **All articles** CSV export (title, category, status, dates, URL). Use it as the inventory and to reconcile the ZIP.

The export does not include snippets, variables, glossary, custom pages, redirects, custom CSS/JS or API specs. Collect those from the live site or ask the customer for them.

The Document360 API (`apihub.document360.io`, customer token) can list categories and articles if the customer prefers to script the export themselves; category responses contain only direct children, so recurse. https://apidocs.document360.com

### From the live site

For public knowledge bases, `/llms.txt` lists every published article and category page, and each article serves markdown at `<article-url>.md`. The sitemap URL is shown in the customer's SEO settings. Quirks (`mint migrate --topic discovery`, Mirror the raw source):

- Strip the `> ## Documentation Index` blockquote after the frontmatter.
- Its frontmatter (`title`, `slug`, `description`, `tags`, `canonical`, dates) is usable source metadata (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Frontmatter).
- Rendered callouts lose their type in `.md` output (only some become `> [!TIP]`-style blockquotes). Take the callout type from the rendered HTML class.

Private and mixed-access content is only in the export (`mint migrate --topic discovery`, Gated content).

## Config → docs.json

| Document360                                      | docs.json                                              |
| ------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| Project name                                     | `name`                                                 |
| Logo (light/dark), favicon                       | `logo.light`, `logo.dark`, `favicon`                   |
| Brand color                                      | `colors.primary`                                       |
| Header and secondary navigation links            | `navbar.links`                                         |
| Footer links                                     | `footer.links`                                         |
| Workspaces used as versions                      | `navigation.versions`                                  |
| Workspaces used as separate products             | `navigation.products` or `navigation.tabs`             |
| Languages                                        | `navigation.languages` if the customer migrates them   |
| Redirect rules                                   | `redirects`                                            |
| Home page builder                                | an MDX home page with the same visible content; report |
| Reader groups, private articles, SSO             | drop and report                                        |
| Custom CSS / JavaScript, integrations, analytics | drop and report                                        |
| Feedback, article ratings, search settings       | drop and report                                        |

## Navigation

Use the category tree from the export folder structure, the CSV `category` column, or the rendered sidebar.

| Document360                        | Mintlify                                                         |
| ---------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Workspace                          | version, product or tab (ask how readers use them)               |
| Folder category (no URL)           | group                                                            |
| Index category (URL, article list) | group whose first page is an overview with links to its articles |
| Page category (URL, content)       | group whose first page is the category's content                 |
| Subcategory                        | nested group                                                     |
| Article, sub-article               | page                                                             |

Take sidebar order from the rendered sidebar unless the export carries an explicit order field. Articles in draft status (CSV `status`) are not published; ask before migrating them.

## Content conversion

Document360 renders the article title as the H1; bodies start at H2. Do not add an H1.

| Document360                                                | Mintlify                                                        |
| ---------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Info callout (`infoBox`)                                   | `<Info>`                                                        |
| Warning callout (`warningBox`)                             | `<Warning>`                                                     |
| Error callout (`errorBox`)                                 | `<Danger>`                                                      |
| Success callout (`successBox`, `> [!TIP]` in `.md` output) | `<Check>`                                                       |
| Callout bold first line                                    | bold first line (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Components) |
| `{{snippet.<code>}}`                                       | snippet (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Reusable content)   |
| `{{variable.<code>}}`                                      | `{{<code>}}` (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Template tags) |
| `{{glossary.<term>}}`                                      | `<Tooltip tip="<definition>">term</Tooltip>`                    |
| Code block with a heading                                  | fence with `title`                                              |
| Tabs, accordions                                           | `<Tabs>`, `<AccordionGroup>`                                    |
| Step-by-step guide                                         | `<Steps>`                                                       |
| Private notes                                              | remove; list them in the report                                 |
| Embedded video, iframe                                     | supported embed, else link                                      |
| Decision trees, forms                                      | static content or link; report                                  |

Merge codes are case-sensitive. Snippet and variable content is not in the export: get each value from the customer or from a rendered page that uses it.

WYSIWYG `.html` articles carry editor wrapper markup; count every distinct `class` value (`mint migrate --topic conversion`).

## Assets

With **Include media files**, images ship in the ZIP; rewrite each reference to its local copy under `images/`. Without it, they are `cdn.document360.io` URLs (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Images and files). Also check Drive file links (downloadable PDFs and attachments), which may point at Document360 storage.

## URLs and redirects

- Build the old URL list from the CSV `URL` column plus `llms.txt` or the sitemap; include Index and Page category URLs.
- Keep the article slug; it is the stable part of the URL. Add redirects for workspace and language prefixes you drop or rename, and for each article whose path changes.
- Folder categories have no URL and need no redirect.

## Known gaps

- Home page builder layouts and custom pages.
- Reader groups and private-content rules.
- API documentation: specs are imported (file, URL or CLI) and not in the export. Ask for the spec file, then follow `mint migrate --topic api`; do not convert the generated endpoint articles.
- Decision trees, article templates, related-articles widgets, feedback and ratings.
